name: YGOMaster-TCG
summary: YGOMaster-TCG is a Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel mod which allows players to go through a single-player, progressive campaign experience themed around the release of the real-life Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG. From Legend of Blue-Eyes White Dragon to Eternity Code, players will open packs from the DM to VRAINS eras and participate in over 450 Duels.
